About Summit Trail Gear

Summit Trail Gear is a small outdoor-equipment company run by people who spend their weekends above the treeline. We began in 2019 as a gear-review newsletter and moved into making our own equipment when we could not find a 45-liter pack that balanced weight, durability, and price the way we wanted.

Questions about an order or a product? Reach the team through the contact page and a human will reply within two business days. See also top, email us, call us, and empty href.
